subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep issue #41372 as a broad routing umbrella, or split the remaining current-main slices into focused canonical issues and then retire the umbrella?
rationale: The report spans config recovery policy, Discord/channel catch-up, cron ergonomics, onboard auth behavior, update process handling, and resource policy; automation cannot safely choose the tracking shape or product defaults from source inspection alone.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link config startup recovery to #85695, missed inbound catch-up to #55792, open only focused current-main follow-ups for remaining slices, and then close this broad tracker.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open until every slice is fixed, rejected, or moved, accepting weaker automation signal because it spans several owners.

options.title: Close as partially superseded
options.body: Close now with links to existing narrower work and ask reporters to re-file any slice that still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link config startup recovery to #85695, missed inbound catch-up to #55792, open only focused current-main follow-ups for remaining slices, and then close this broad tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is primarily cross-surface product routing and config/channel policy, where this history has the strongest adjacent decision signal.
